title: Electric Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The total electric field expression must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Maxima and Minima Positions
description: Essential Criteria: The positions of the maxima and minima of <E^2> must be accurately determined.

title: Magnetic Field Phase Change
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning for the phase change of the magnetic field upon reflection must be clearly explained.

title: Magnetic Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the total magnetic field B(z, t) must be correctly derived.

title: Average Magnetic Field
description: Important Criteria: The average value <B^2> must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Darkening Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation for the cause of darkening on the photographic plate must be logically concluded.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the derivation of electric and magnetic fields must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the derivations and final expressions.
